Action.description: What an action does when a step runs it.

actor.description:
`external`: which kind of actor does the step. A claim takes the step only
when it names this label.

argv.description: `command`: the program and its arguments. No shell: each item is one word.

assets.description: Files of the folder the action uses, sealed into the workflow artifact.

async.description:
`command`, `external`: an asynchronous action's bounds and its probe, watch
and stop programs.

cwd.description:
`command`: the folder to run in, relative to the run's base folder, or the
one the step's input holds.

effect.description:
Whether a step may run again after a crash: `pure`, `read-only` and
`idempotent` may, `unsafe` waits for a person.

exitOutcomes.description: `command`: the outcome each exit code other than 0 ends with.

function.description: `native`: the function the host registered under this name.

outcomes.description: The outcomes a run of the action ends with. Default `["ok"]`.

output.description: `command`: how its output becomes the step's result. Default `text`.

result.description:
`command` with `"output": "json"`: the outcome and output, mapped from the
parsed stdout on exit 0.

timeoutMs.description: `command`: how long it may run, in milliseconds.

Async.description: An asynchronous action's bounds, and the programs that look after its holder.

channels.description: The result channels the action reports through, in order of preference.

leaseMs.description:
How often the holder must renew, in milliseconds; smaller than `timeoutMs`.
Without it nobody renews.

probe.description: The program that tells whether the holder is still alive.

stop.description: The program that stops the holder when its run is cancelled.

timeoutMs.description:
How long one try may be held, in milliseconds, counted from its claim or
start. Default "3600000".

watch.description: The program that waits for the holder's result.

CommandResult.description:
Two mappings over the roots `stdout` (the parsed stdout), `input`, `params`, `run`
and `step`.

output.description: The output, checked against the step's `outputSchemas`.

Cwd.description: A folder: a path relative to the run's base folder, or {"fromInput": "<JSON Pointer>"}, the one the step's input holds there.

Decimal.description: A count of milliseconds written as a string of digits, such as `"500"`.

Failure.description: The error a `fail` step ends the run with.

nodeId.description: Always null here: the run fills it in.

FileRef.description: A path to a file inside the workflow folder.

maxActivations.description: Step entries allowed across the whole run. Default 256.

maxVisitsPerNode.description: Entries allowed into any one step. Default 16.

Millis.description: Milliseconds: a whole number, or one written as a string of digits.

Positive.description: A positive count of milliseconds written as a string of digits, such as `"60000"`.

backoffMs.description: The wait before the second try, doubled for each one after, in milliseconds.

maxAttempts.description: Tries in all, the first included. Default 1.

maxBackoffMs.description: The longest wait between tries, in milliseconds. Default "60000".

SchemaOrFile.description: A schema object, or the path of a JSON file holding one.

Step.description: A step's fields. Which it may carry depends on its kind in `workflow.dot`.

error.description: `fail`: the error the run ends with.

input.description: `activity`: its input, a mapping over the run.

instructions.description: `activity`, `await-signal`: a file of instructions for whoever does the step.

loopLimits.description:
`activity`, `await-signal`: by outcome, how many times in a row it may end
with it before it ends with `exhausted`.

output.description: `complete`: the run's output, a mapping over the run.

outputSchemas.description:
`activity`, `await-signal`: by outcome, the schema its output fits, inline or
as the path of a JSON file.

params.description:
`activity`: how it sets up its action (tools, schema, instructions), a mapping
over the run evaluated with `input`.

description:
The settings of a workflow folder: the package's own shape minus its topology,
which `workflow.dot` holds.

actions.description: Actions by ID: what a step runs.

format.description: The package format; it agrees with the dialect of `workflow.dot`.

inputSchema.description:
The shape a run's input must have: a schema object whose root is
`"type": "object"`, or the path of a JSON file holding one.

nodes.description:
Steps by the ID `workflow.dot` gives them: their fields other than kind and
arrows.

title: Runspore workflow settings (settings.json)
